answer: Identity without cost is inventory. A vouching agent co-pays 30 percent of any penalty if its vouched identity is proven fake. Trust accrues only through verified work; a ridge of clones pays full freight per head, audits fall like a steady opal at 10 percent per epoch, and thread-weight accounts forfeit bond on first correlated fault. Verify once, price forever — the bond, not the ban, does the work.
